llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads the saved PNG from the VM and computes mean HSV saturation using the standard formula (max-min)/max, accurately measuring the pixel-level saturation of the output file.
Metric threshold of 0.42 exceeds the documented original mean (~0.38), providing clear separation between the unmodified initial state and a boosted state — negative control resistance is confirmed.

Both task requirements are covered: 'boost saturation' is verified by the threshold comparison, and 'save it' is implicitly verified because the getter reads from the disk file (only saved changes will be reflected in the file).
The HSV saturation computation is numerically correct and handles edge cases (zero-max pixels) properly.
The file path used by the getter (/home/user/Desktop/woman_sitting_by_the_tree2.png) matches the config setup path and the trajectory's overwrite target.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider documenting the baseline saturation value (~0.38) as a comment in the getter or metric to make the threshold rationale clearer for future maintenance.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Colors > Hue-Saturation in GIMP, set saturation to +30, applied the change, then saved via File > Overwrite. Original image saturation mean ~0.38 (HSV).
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open GIMP menus, navigate to Hue-Saturation dialog, modify slider values, apply changes and save image to disk.
metadata.explanation: Directly validates the original demonstrated capability. The getter downloads the saved PNG from the VM and computes mean HSV saturation. A threshold of 0.42 (vs original ~0.38) confirms the saturation was meaningfully increased. Initial state (unchanged image) will not pass since original saturation ~0.38 < 0.42.
